overall: The AG found no violation on the complaint's allegation that 16 sets of 2019-2020 executive session minutes were wrongly withheld, declining a broad review on a generalized allegation. It noted, and the Board conceded, a past failure to periodically review executive session minutes, and ordered no specific remedy.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board wrongly withholds 16 sets of 2019-2020 executive session minutes (five from 2020, eleven from 2019) from public release.
allegations.key_passage: Accordingly, we decline to conduct a broad review of the minutes of 16 separate executive session meetings based on a generalized allegation that all of the minutes are being wrongfully withheld.

allegations.summary: Not raised by the complainant; the AG reminded the Board of its duty to periodically review executive session minutes, which the Board conceded it had not done.
allegations.key_passage: although we note, and the Board acknowledges, that the Board failed to periodically review its executive minutes as required by the Open Meeting Law.
